descriptions.d16f_screen_capture_a_80347ab8: Captures the first controller's rendered frame into a retained surface sized to the renderer, then writes it as a bitmap: to the given path, or to the first unused Screen%03d.bmp name found by probing the file system with a persistent counter; returns the open error or 0.
descriptions.d16f_screen_capture_b_80348f2c: Captures the second controller's rendered frame into a retained surface sized to the renderer, then writes it as a bitmap: to the given path, or to the first unused Screen%03d.bmp name found by probing the file system with its own persistent counter; returns the open error or 0.
